title: Child Development Core
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 8S/12Q to fewer than 16S/24Q units

outcomes: Create highly engaging, stimulating, and safe learning environments that promote the holistic development of young children.
Examine children's individual differences and plan intentional learning experiences based on the unique developmental abilities and interests of the children in their care.
Apply critical thinking skills to explain early childhood and child development theories to inform teaching principles and practices.
Observe, analyze, and document children's learning and development while demonstrating proficiency in written and oral communication.
Value positive relationships with others and demonstrate an inclusive and culturally responsive approach in interactions with children, families, colleagues, staff, and community.

notes: The catalog prints 'CDEV C1000'; the closed list stores it as 'CDEVC1000' (no space). Treated as the same closed-list course, not a catalog addition.
Footnote 1 on Required Courses: 3 of the 4 above courses must be completed at Cerritos College (residency rule, not a course-choice rule).
